recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the Applied FHIR-core request with narrowly scoped source corrections; no further core FHIR change is recommended for FHIR-53414.
issue_request: FHIR-53414 was Applied/Persuasive for R6 and requested EventDefinition examples for named events, data events, data events with profiles, and periodic events, plus corrected invariants and guidance clarifying that condition can be used on any trigger type while data-change triggers supply the current/previous data context.
initial_application: The issue was initially applied in git commit 9d991985584b523259912d1afd9c4489d1bcc2dd, linked from Jira via PR 3971. That commit added the EventDefinition example resources, example list entries, ExampleEventDefinitionLogic, EventDefinition notes, and TriggerDefinition spreadsheet edits, but left issue-scoped inconsistencies in condition context wording, the invariant XPath, and narrative example snippets.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini shows EventDefinition and TriggerDefinition are active current-build artifacts. Community searches found no relevant Zulip or Confluence discussion that changed the Jira/source conclusion. A broad Jira search also surfaced FHIR-53459, but that issue belongs to FHIR-us-cql and was not a core FHIR reconciliation target.
reconciliation: Published a source-changing commit that updates TriggerDefinition guidance and the condition comment to limit current/previous data context to data-change triggers, synchronizes the required-type-elements XPath with the FHIRPath invariant, and updates EventDefinition notes to use the checked-in consecutivelyAfter helper name and the same stick-test profile URL as the example resource.
source_changes: source/datatypes/triggerdefinition.xml: clarified general TriggerDefinition guidance so condition can refine any trigger type while data-change triggers provide current/previous data context.

source/datatypes/triggerdefinition.xml: updated TriggerDefinition.condition guidance to avoid saying every trigger supplies a current resource context and to use the current data-removed trigger code.

source/datatypes/triggerdefinition.xml: updated the required-type-elements XPath invariant to match the FHIRPath rule for named-event name-or-code, periodic timing, data requirements, and subscriptionTopic.

source/eventdefinition/eventdefinition-notes.xml: aligned the narrative CQL snippets with ExampleEventDefinitionLogic.consecutivelyAfter and the example-data-with-profile resource's stick-test profile URL.
